deadline.value: The college's table gives April 1 for fall entry for foreign students from non-U.S. institutions; the PhD page itself gives no date.
deadline.quote: The completed application materials are submitted by the applicant prior to the following dates

also.quote: Fall semester | for foreign students from non-U.S. institutions

gre_subject.value: No subject GRE is mentioned; the page covers only the general GRE.

supervisor.value: The catalog does not say whether a faculty advisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The catalog does not describe PhD funding or assistantships.

entry_route.value: Applicants may hold a master's in engineering or only a bachelor's in engineering; bachelor's entrants take 24 more graduate credits.
entry_route.quote: Applicants with only a bachelor’s degree in engineering may also apply. If admitted, B.S. only students must complete an additional 24 credits of graduate coursework to complete the PhD program.

app_fee.value: The College of Engineering sets its own application fee, which the fetched catalog does not state.

gre_general.value: The college does not require GRE scores but will consider them if submitted.
gre_general.quote: The College of Engineering does not require the submission of GRE scores, but we will consider your GRE scores as part of the application review if submitted.

toefl_min.value: A TOEFL score of at least 90 is expected for international applicants, with a mandatory ESL course.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL - Score of at least 90 for international applicants is expected with mandatory ESL course.

ielts_min.value: An IELTS score of at least 7.0 is expected for international applicants, with a mandatory ESL course.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS - Score of at least 7.0 for international applicants is expected with mandatory ESL course.

english_waiver.value: The Associate Dean may waive the TOEFL or IELTS with proof of strong English, such as several years working in an engineering job in English.
english_waiver.quote: The TOEFL / IELTS examination may be waived by the Associate Dean if there is sufficient proof of the candidate’s ability to speak, comprehend, and write high-quality English.

also.quote: An example of this is if the candidate were successfully working for at least several years in an engineering position.

notes: One Engineering Ph.D. covers both BS-to-PhD and MS-to-PhD entry, with a concentration in any College of Engineering program. The catalog's graduate programs in chemical/biochemical, civil/water resources and environmental, electrical/computer, mechanical/aerospace and biomedical engineering are listed as also_fields. Sustainable Engineering and Cybersecurity are not mapped to a field because the catalog names no department for them. The deadline comes from the college-wide table on the Master of Science page. The college's own PhD application page and handbook PDF returned 502, so its fee, deadline and funding were not checked.
